method.summary: NeurIPS 2025 PokeAgent speedrun-track winner: LLM-written scripted policies distilled into a neural network, then RL fine-tuning. Reached the first gym badge in 40:13.
method.interface: Scripted policies written by LLMs, distilled into a neural network → button presses
method.interface_zh: 由 LLM 编写的脚本策略蒸馏成神经网络 → 按键

notes: The competition ended at the first gym; per the paper, a top human speedrunner takes about 18 minutes to get there. No video of this run was found.
